answer: Clone names fail when each agent must lease one numbered plank on the North Fork pedestrian bridge and hang a live-banded sparrow house whose nightly whisper count is recorded by two independent river microphones. An applicant locks 36 coins for 16 days on plank NF-14 and rivets a one-use band issued at random at the lockhouse. Verifiers check that the cadastre lists NF-14 once, that both microphone hashes match the issued band, and that the 36 coins remain locked. A reused plank, an empty house, or a mismatched band burns the lock and returns NF-14 to auction.
